verdict.rationale: Square's docs explicitly cover in-person contactless cards, Apple Pay, and other digital wallets via Tap to Pay on iPhone and the Mobile Payments SDK. Its docs also describe processing payments on Square hardware and the Terminal API checkout flow, and a community comment describes card-in-reader with PIN entry, which implies chip support. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of EMV chip acceptance, explicit naming of Google Pay, independent hands-on corroboration of the wallet and contactless flows.
